items: Workflow Orchestration As The Enterprise Control Tower

Virtual Agent Under Scoped Retrieval
The virtual agent answers only from scoped sources — deflection measured by resolution, not by silence.

Prebuilt connectors governed like code — scoped credentials and logged flows.

Open table formats underneath everything we build, so your data never belongs to a vendor.

data contracts
Typed schemas with owners and freshness expectations, agreed before a pipeline is allowed to ship.
